case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that you want to keep supporting our operations with reliable delivery. Our options put the whole fastener kit under one agreement with you, with a binding volume that gives your plant one steady, planned load.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the longest contract term and a fixed yearly volume, and the claims below show why the price sits where it does.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our price history with you:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.86; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.91; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.88; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since this is a decision beyond inside sales, please take Option A to the person who decides on your side. For them, it is simple: one agreement for the whole kit, a binding volume over the full term, and a partner who plans with you.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

While we note the historical price stability of the individual components you cited, providing the complete bundled kit requires a sustainable price basis. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

We can present a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

We appreciate your commitment to a binding volume over a 36-month term and can accommodate the 45-day payment terms requested in your Option A. We can therefore offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.58 for this package. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €5.58 per unit, alongside a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that providing the complete bundled kit requires a sustainable price basis. Option A gives your plant exactly the footing for that: the whole kit under one agreement, a binding volume and the longest contract term, so your load is steady and planned.

Thank you for taking the time to check the price history and the volume change. On your cost drivers, here is what our own orders show:

Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.95; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.00; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.97; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives you a long, planned commitment while the price on a part we buy from you has held steady.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As the price is above what you may decide alone, I would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who decides on your side, so that we can close this together as two family-run companies.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
